name: Pyre caller
description: an elder hell imp, hunched and round, with a ragged cloak of soot, dark ashen skin, yellow eyes, one fist burning with a small fire from which sparks crawl

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, larger and rounder than a normal imp, a ragged cloak of sooty ash around its shoulders, one fist held up wreathed in fire, tiny orange sparks crawling off its fingers
poses.struck: just hit and caught mid-shriek: eyes bulging, mouth stretched open, wings snapped up, body tilted back with cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: bursting apart in a small round pop of black soot and bright orange embers, only its horns tumbling out of the puff

idle.action: hovers, flapping heavily, the burning fist swaying

attack.action: lifts the burning fist and a small living spark of fire crawls out of it and drifts away, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a yelp, wings crumpling, then recovers

die.action: shrieks, swells with orange light shining through the cracks in its skin, and pops like a firecracker into a puff of black soot and embers
